name: Ball Drop
description: A bouncing-ball arp: it starts as a rapid flutter of sixty-fourth-note blips and relaxes down to a lazy eighth over one bar, smoothly. Great as a breakdown pickup or a trailing fill.

name: Cinder
description: A crunchy, lo-fi chip-tune arp: video-game and oscillator-chip tables with a gritty edge and a quick decay, saturated just enough to sound like it came from a vintage console.

name: Glass Staircase
description: A bright, fast-decaying FM pluck made for arpeggiators: each note starts glassy and rounds off, answered by a triplet echo that fills the gaps between steps.

name: Heartbeat Sway
description: A swung, syncopated arp that breathes: up-and-down over a dotted-eighth feel with a loose, humanised touch. Organic, soft-edged and warm - a deep-house bedroom groove.

name: Heliograph
description: A bright, cutting hard-sync arp: a sine restarts several times per cycle and the ratio collapses as each note decays, sending a flash of light off every step.

name: Lunar Steps
description: A staccato electric-piano arp with a tremolo shimmer and a long triplet echo - dreamy and a little melancholic, like footsteps in low gravity.

name: Moonlit Cascade
description: A latched, drifting cascade: three octaves of triplet sixteenths converging towards the middle, long gates and a wide echo. Press a chord once and walk away - it keeps playing.

name: Moss Garden
description: A soft, breathy flute-and-mallet arp: hollow and organic with a gentle Perlin sway on the stereo image, as if the notes were drifting between leaves.

name: Offbeat Orchard
description: Chord stabs on the off-beat eighths: every held note at once, a warm electric piano with a marimba overtone, chorus and a slow echo. Deep-house chord rhythm without programming a thing.

name: Paper Boats
description: A gentle acoustic-guitar arp with a soft piano glow: warm, rounded and unhurried. Sits comfortably behind a vocal or a sparse pad.

name: Pebble Beach
description: A smooth, wooden marimba arp with a stereo-spread pair of tones an octave apart - round and rhythmic, like pebbles dropped one at a time into still water.

name: Pulse Garden Stutter
description: Chords in a gallop that periodically surge: the arp swells to a roll and settles back every two bars, snapping to musical subdivisions. Melodic house with a pulse that keeps changing.

name: Rolling Gold
description: Hold a chord and it rolls upward over two octaves in sixteenths, the downbeats accented: a bright FM pluck with a glassy overtone and a dotted echo. The classic melodic-house top line, ready to play.

name: Silver Thread
description: A taut, shimmering string-pluck arp: the pluck-position table with a bright FM edge and a fast filter pinch. Thin, precise and sparkly - the needle in the mix.

name: Staccato Choir
description: Short, rhythmic voice stabs for arpeggiating: a recorded human voice on a tight envelope with a vowel shift on every note. Sounds like a vocalist chopped to a metronome.

name: Stutter Rise
description: A build in one patch: the arp starts at eighths and accelerates through sixteenths to thirty-seconds over a bar, then snaps back. Hold a chord into the drop; louder as it speeds up.

name: Syncopation Station
description: A sustained chord chopped into a syncopated sixteen-step pattern (a classic 3-3-2 feel) that locks to the host tempo. Instant groove from a single held chord.

name: Trance Gate Sunrise
description: Hold a chord and a sixteen-step gate pattern, locked to the host tempo, chops it into a rolling rhythm - a trance-gate pad that needs no sequencer. The filter opens slowly like a sunrise.

name: Acid Lamp
description: A resonant, squelchy acid bass that reacts to velocity: soft notes purr, hard notes scream. Short, snappy filter envelope in the 303 tradition.

name: Amber Pulse
description: Sidechain-pumped bass that ducks on every beat in time with the host. A warm electric-bass tone with the gaps built in, ready for a four-on-the-floor kick.

name: Back Alley Reese
description: A classic dark reese: two blended-wave oscillators detuned against each other so the low end phases and growls, with the filter creeping slowly.

name: Basement Warmth
description: Deep-house sub with a slow breathing filter. Pure and round, with a tube-warm edge that blooms when you push the mod wheel.

name: Bouncer
description: A playful, elastic bass: an eighth-note downward LFO makes the level bounce, with a resonant filter that squelches on the way up.

name: Coal Fire
description: A snarling, harmonically dense bass built from a distorted-waveform table and a wavefolder. Gritty but controlled - the Grit macro takes it from smoulder to roar.

name: Concrete Garden
description: A rolling melodic-house bassline: a recorded electric bass for the body, a saw an octave down for bite, and a filter that snaps open on every note. Velocity opens it further.

name: Dub Cathedral
description: A short, round bass note thrown into a huge dotted echo and a long reverb - play one note and let the room do the rest. Pure dub-techno weight.

name: Heartbeat
description: A deep, thumping sub with a quick downward pitch drop on every note - half bass, half kick. Short notes make a pulse, long notes a boom.

name: Low Tide
description: A hollow, swaying bass: a pulse wave and a digital bass table, with a half-note LFO that lets the filter wash in and out like water.

name: Marrow
description: A plucked acoustic-guitar tone dropped into the bass register: woody, staccato and very organic. Lovely for syncopated lines in organic house.

name: Moon Drop
description: A long, dramatic pitch fall between notes: a mono bass with a slow glide on every note, so each line swoops into place. Great for one-note rolls and big breakdown moves; shorten the Glide knob for a subtler slur.

name: Night Shift
description: Played-in electric bass that responds to touch: soft notes stay dark and round, hard notes get bright and growly. Very organic under a vocal or a pad.

name: Organic Root
description: A warm, played-in bass built from a real electric-bass recording with a marimba-like overtone an octave up. Round, woody and very natural.

name: Rolling Thunder
description: A bass that carries its own filter: the table opens along with the envelope, so every note has a built-in growl with no filter needed. Warm and punchy.

name: Tarmac
description: Metallic FM growl with an eighth-note synced sweep of the modulation index - the sound of a bassline chewing on gravel. Tight and aggressive.

name: Tidal Slide
description: The pitch-slide bassline: a mono, legato sub that glides between notes that overlap and stays tight on the ones that don't. Hold a note, play the next, and it slides home. Play it long and slow under a breakdown.

name: Under The Pier
description: A hollow, whistling sub with an eerie theremin edge that drifts on a slow chaotic wander. Moody and spacious - great in a breakdown.

name: Velvet Rope
description: A low bowed-cello bass: soft attack, woody and human. Plays beautifully under slow chords; lean on the wheel for more bow pressure.

name: Warm Machine
description: A digital bass table under a square an octave down, with a gentle envelope sweep - analogue-flavoured warmth from a very digital recipe.

name: Afterglow Stab
description: A wide brass-and-voice stab that swells open on the attack and glows down afterwards. Cinematic, a little triumphant, and big enough to lead a chorus section.

name: Dub Chord
description: A soft, filtered chord thrown into a huge feedback echo and a deep reverb, the echo darkening with every repeat. Play one chord and let it dissolve - pure dub techno.

name: Gravel Road
description: A dirty, grinding stab from distorted waves and a folded sine: abrasive and harmonically dense, a rough counterpoint to smoother elements in the mix.

name: Minor Nine Mist
description: A soft, extended-chord stab: piano, electric piano and glass partials blurred into a misty bloom with a long tail. Made for jazzy minor-ninth voicings.

name: Offbeat Silk
description: A sustained, silky chord that only speaks on the offbeats: a stepped pattern locked to the host tempo gates it into the classic house 'and' of every beat. Hold a chord and it grooves by itself.

name: Orchestra Hit Lite
description: A compact orchestral hit: brass, cello and voice layered in a single thick stab with a long hall tail. Dramatic, a bit old-school, and very big.

name: Pillow Stab
description: A soft, rounded stab from flute and electric piano - warm, forgiving and impossible to make harsh. Sits low in a mix and fills the middle without fighting anything.

name: Rave Memory
description: A raw, nostalgic rave stab: detuned waves, a video-game table for grit, and a hard-sync snap, pushed into saturation. Sounds like a warehouse in 1992.

name: Sunday Chord
description: A warm, soulful stab from electric piano and organ together, softened by chorus: the sound of a chord sampled off a dusty soul record.

name: Velvet Organ Hit
description: A short organ hit with a whirling Leslie-style shimmer, tube-warmed and bright on top. Big club-organ energy for syncopated stabs.

name: Vocal Chop Chord
description: A chord of 'ooh's: recorded voices on a snappy envelope with a formant sweep that opens on every hit. Sounds like a sampled vocal stab without a sample in sight.

name: Warehouse Stab
description: The peak-time house stab: bright detuned waves with a hard-sync layer, a quick filter snap and a dotted echo. Sharp, wide and made to be played on the offbeat.

name: Cinema Riser
description: A strings-and-voice riser that opens slowly over eight seconds: recorded violin and cello with a choir behind them, the filter swelling from dark to blazing. Emotional and grand.

name: Glitch Burst
description: A short flurry of random stutters: sample-and-hold flicks the wave position, the filter and the pan across a chip-and-snippet table pair, then dissolves into a triplet echo. Instant fill material.

name: Gravity Well
description: The opposite of a riser: noise and a detuned stack that collapse downward as the filter closes, falling into a deep reverb. Drops onto the downbeat as a tail or a breakdown pull.

name: Impact Hall
description: A single, enormous hit: a burst of noise with a sub boom underneath, slamming into a huge hall reverb. Place it on the downbeat after a riser.

name: Laser Rain
description: A shower of fast hard-sync zaps with a long, regenerating triplet echo: each note fires a laser that rains down through the stereo field.

name: Shimmer Burst
description: A bright, fast burst of glass and bell partials that explodes into a long, glittering reverb and a dotted echo. A short, expensive-sounding transition hit.

name: Ship Horn
description: A deep foghorn drone: a low brass tone and cello with a long release, warmed by saturation and washed in a cavernous reverb. Cinematic, lonely and enormous.

name: Sub Fall
description: A huge falling sub: a pure sine whose pitch drops steadily for the length of the note and a long exponential decay, for breakdown drops and cinematic impacts.

name: Sweep Of Doom
description: A long, resonant filter sweep over a dark saw stack, driven by a four-bar triangle LFO locked to the host. Automate Macro 1 by hand to ride it.

name: Tension Rising
description: The classic build: white noise and a wide supersaw rise together over eight seconds as the high-pass opens and a pitch-like sweep climbs. Hold a note into the drop.

name: Whale Song
description: A slow, mournful call from the deep: a theremin and a low recorded voice gliding upward by a few cents with every note, wavering in vibrato and lost in a gigantic reverb.

name: Wind Up
description: A tonal riser that winds up like a spring: a sharp spectral peak climbs through the harmonics as noise thickens underneath. Shorter and more musical than a noise sweep - sits inside the harmony.

name: Basic Saw
description: Plain single saw through a lowpass. The blank canvas - every parameter at its default.

name: Bright Kodak
description: A bright, snappy electric piano with an almost glassy bark, tightened up by an envelope on the wave position. Sunny, sparkly and great for uptempo grooves.

name: Dusty Wurli
description: A gritty, bright electric piano with a hint of clavinet snap on top, warmed by tube saturation and a sweep of slow phasing. Crunchy, funky and full of character.

name: Glass Piano
description: A soft piano whose upper register is lit from within by glass harmonics: delicate, bell-like and slow to decay, in a long hushed reverb.

name: Gospel Hum
description: A full tonewheel organ with a percussive key-click transient from a marimba tone, tube-warmed and chorused. Church-basement soul in a plugin.

name: Honeyed Keys
description: A warm electric-piano body with a marimba overtone floating above it, wrapped in chorus and a slow dotted echo. Golden, sweet and slightly nostalgic.

name: Late Bloom Organ
description: A tonewheel organ with a recorded body and added drawbar upper partials, run through a Leslie-style chorus. The mod wheel speeds the rotary up from a lazy swirl to a shimmer.

name: Moon Pool
description: A dreamy electric piano floating on a bed of breathy flute, deep in echo and chorus. Weightless, hazy and slow - like keys heard from the bottom of a swimming pool.

name: Nocturne
description: A felted, intimate piano with the highs rolled well back - close-miked, quiet and a little sad. Plays beautifully in sparse, slow voicings.

name: Pocket Piano
description: A tiny, lo-fi toy piano: marimba and piano cycles pushed through a touch of tube grit with a wonky pitch drift. Charming, plinky and perfect for quirky hooks.

name: Rhodes At 3AM
description: A recorded electric-piano tone with a bell-like FM tine that fades after each strike, a gentle tremolo, and a worn chorus. The sound of the last chord of the night.

name: Stage Left
description: A layered piano and electric piano panned apart - the grand on the left, the Wurlitzer on the right - for a wide, played-in-a-room stereo image that glues itself together.

name: Sunday Morning
description: A soft piano with a nylon-guitar shadow: the two recorded tones blend into something warm and homey, with a gentle echo. Slow breakfast, sunlight on the floor.

name: Tine Tears
description: Pure, singing tines: an FM tone and a recorded electric piano blended so the sine-like fundamental rings clean. A slow tremolo makes it weep.

name: Velvet Clav
description: A funky clavinet with a recorded pluck and a wah-like filter that snaps open with velocity: play softly for a muted chick, hard for a biting slap.

name: Brass Heart
description: A soulful synth-brass lead: the table opens with a swell on every note and an alto-sax layer adds breathy body. Punchy attack, warm sustain, perfect for stabbing melodies.

name: Casio Heart
description: A shimmering, digital phase-distortion lead with a pulse underneath, like a beloved keyboard from 1985: bright, slightly cheesy in the best way, and full of vibrato.

name: Choir Of One
description: A single sung voice for a lead: a recorded human-voice table with a formant filter that shapes the vowel. Macro 2 morphs the vowel; aftertouch adds a breath of vibrato.

name: Desert Flute
description: A breathy flute lead with a hint of clarinet and a dusting of air. The mod wheel brightens the tone and pushes it toward overblown; aftertouch adds expressive vibrato.

name: Firefly
description: A small, bright, plucky lead: FM and glass tones with a fast envelope and a triplet echo that makes every note flicker. Cute, quick and very easy to play.

name: Glass Hymn
description: An ethereal, bell-like lead: sparse glass harmonics and a pure FM tone that shimmer together, with a slow Perlin drift on the wave position so it never sits still.

name: Lasers In The Fog
description: A cutting hard-sync lead whose sweep is slowly steered by a synced LFO, wrapped in a dotted echo and a hazy reverb - bright lasers seen through mist.

name: Midnight Sax
description: A smoky, breathy alto-sax lead with a warm tube glow. Soft touches stay velvety, hard touches growl. Wonderful for slow, soulful melodies.

name: Neon Silk
description: A smooth melodic-house topline: detuned blended waves with a recorded voice breathing through the top, gentle vibrato, chorus and a dotted echo. Sings without sounding like a synth preset.

name: Oboe At Dawn
description: A reedy, vocal oboe lead that sits somewhere between an instrument and a voice. Nasal and bright at the attack, softening into a warm sustain as the vowel layer fades in.

name: Prism Lead
description: A bright, many-faceted lead from overtone and hand-drawn tables: slightly irregular, glassy and animated by a slow drift on both oscillators. Distinctive and a little otherworldly.

name: Satin Fold
description: A buzzy West-Coast lead: a sine folded harder and harder by Macro 2, with a warm sub-octave under it so it never gets thin. Smooth when played soft, rich when pushed.

name: Solar Flare
description: Anthemic supersaw for the big moment: three layers of detuned blended waves spread wide, with a bright sync-sweep layer on top. Euphoric and unashamedly huge.

name: Spire
description: A soaring lead where a sharp spectral peak climbs through the harmonics as you hold the note, with a recorded voice underneath for body. Dramatic and vocal.

name: Sunrise Slide
description: A smooth mono lead that slurs from note to note with a gentle glide, like a vocal. Soft saw and a touch of chorus, with a dotted-eighth echo that follows the slides.

name: Sunset Boulevard
description: A singing electric-guitar lead with a touch of overdrive and a long, slow echo - cinematic and warm, built for wide-open melodies at golden hour.

name: Violet Hour
description: A bowed lead with the warmth of a violin and the depth of a cello under it, swelling in on a soft attack. Romantic, a little sad, and very human.

name: Whistle Down The Line
description: A pure, wavering theremin-style lead that breathes in and out of vibrato under your fingers: aftertouch deepens the wobble, the mod wheel adds an eerie edge.

name: Bamboo Pipes
description: A hollow pan-pipe pad: flute and clarinet cycles with a bed of pink-noise breath and a soft bandpass shimmer. Airy, soft-edged and meditative.

name: Birdsong Garden
description: A morning garden: recorded bird-call cycles whistling and chirping high above a quiet flute bed, in a bright, airy space. Use sparingly for organic sparkle.

name: Campfire
description: A low, warm crackling fire with a slow acoustic-guitar drone breathing beneath it. Cosy, intimate and deeply analogue.

name: Cello Fog
description: A low, bowed-cello drone-pad that rolls in like fog: slow attack, subtle vibrato, a sub-octave of warmth underneath. Sombre, woody and a little haunted.

name: Desert Strings
description: An exotic, nasal string pad: violin and oboe cycles stacked and widened with a slow drift, warm and slightly bitter, like a caravan heard across a dune.

name: Handpan Sunset
description: A resonant, steel-drum-like handpan voice: Fibonacci-bell partials over a round mallet body, blooming into a long reverb and a warm dotted echo. Golden-hour organic house in one note.

name: Kora Dreams
description: A cascading harp-lute voice: two recorded guitar tones panned apart with a pluck-position shimmer, letting notes ring together into a blurry arpeggio. Flowing, exotic and delicate.

name: Ocean Breath
description: A slow tide of filtered noise that swells and recedes, with a faint tuned hum buried underneath. A natural bed for intros and breakdowns that never loops.

name: Rain On Leaves
description: A fine, tactile patter of crackle-noise rain with a faint, high bell tone floating above it. Light, fresh and lo-fi - drop it under anything for instant atmosphere.

name: Riverside Flute
description: A sustained breathy flute with a trace of wind and a slow vibrato that builds with aftertouch. Open-air, warm, and slightly imperfect in all the right ways.

name: Thumb Piano Hollow
description: A hollow, buzzy thumb-piano with a wooden resonator ring: clarinet and mallet cycles with a little FM bell on top. Tuned, woody and slightly wonky.

name: Tribal Drone
description: A deep, throbbing drone: a low recorded voice with a sub, a vowel-like formant pulse locked to the half note. Hypnotic, ritualistic and heavy.

name: Wind Through Reeds
description: Whistling wind through tall reeds: bandpassed noise whose centre drifts on two slow rhythms, with a clarinet whisper underneath. Spooky, spacious and always moving.

name: Wooden Heart
description: A tuned, hollow wood-block heartbeat: a pitched mallet with a short noise knock, tight and dry. Plays as a rhythmic, melodic percussion layer.

name: Amber Hour
description: A classic warm analogue pad with a pulsing heart: pulse-width modulation locked to the bar gives that breathing, slightly hollow shimmer. Golden-hour house at its finest.

name: Aurora Drift
description: A slowly shifting wash of recorded voice, detuned waves and a thin glitter of glass harmonics. Three different movements run at once - filter, wave position and stereo drift - so it never repeats.

name: Cathedral Of Rain
description: A tonewheel-organ chord swell under a haze of fine rain crackle, bathed in a very long reverb. Sacred, grey and quietly beautiful.

name: Deep Space Choir
description: A huge, low choir with a theremin whistle floating above it and a sub underneath, in a ten-second reverb. The sound of something very large, very far away, singing.

name: Dream Archive
description: An old-tape dream pad: tonewheel and hand-drawn waves pitch-wobbled by a slow wow-and-flutter LFO, saturated and chorused into a warm, blurred memory.

name: Ghost Choir
description: An eerie, half-heard choir: recorded voices drifting through vowel shapes on a very slow synced LFO, with a long shadowy reverb behind them. Wide, hollow and cinematic.

name: Glasshouse
description: Bright, clean and almost architectural: glass harmonics and FM tones stacked in thirds and fifths, with a shimmering octave above. Crystalline without being harsh.

name: Horizon
description: A vast, rising pad for breakdowns: three oscillators of voice, strings and waves stacked wide, with the filter slowly opening over the whole length of the held chord.

name: Lantern Fields
description: A breathing wind-instrument pad: flute and clarinet cycles with a bed of pink-noise air, warmed by a gentle formant filter that opens and closes like lungs.

name: Mercury
description: A liquid-metal pad: a resonant spectral peak slides through the harmonics on a slow synced sweep, with a Fibonacci-bell shimmer riding on top. Silvery, moving and slightly unreal.

name: Midnight Bloom
description: A pad that opens like a flower: it starts dark and muffled and the table and filter swell open over four seconds. Hold a chord and let it unfold.

name: Opal
description: A milky, hollow-glassy pad from the FM 1:2 table, with a second FM layer a fifth up, rippling very slowly. Soft pastel colours and a faint metallic sheen.

name: Pulse Garden
description: A pumping pad with a built-in rhythm: a stepped pattern locked to the host tempo ducks the chord into an eighth-note groove, no sidechain needed. Press and hold for instant movement.

name: Quiet Harbour
description: A soft, safe-feeling pad from electric-piano and flute cycles: gentle, rounded and unhurried, like boats at rest. Beautiful under a sparse melody.

name: Salt And Smoke
description: A dark, smoky pad of brass swell and a breathy alto-sax tone through a low filter, warmed by tube saturation. Sultry, slow and a little dangerous.

name: Slow Dissolve
description: A random-spectrum pad that morphs between four different timbres and then does it again somewhere else. Nothing here repeats - Perlin and the Lorenz attractor take turns steering.

name: Sundial
description: A calm, hollow pad built from overtone and hand-drawn tables whose waves slowly trade places over four-bar cycles. Meditative, with an almost organ-like stillness.

name: Tidal Bloom
description: A pad that is built harmonic by harmonic: the additive table fills in as a slow LFO swells, while a comb-filtered layer ripples through the stereo field like a flanger frozen in water.

name: Velvet Dusk
description: Warm string-section pad: recorded cello and violin cycles blended and widened, with a slow bow-like swell and a shimmer of vibrato. Plush, dark and romantic.

name: Warm Static
description: A lo-fi, tape-saturated pad with a gritty granular layer and a bed of soft noise, like a memory played back on a broken cassette. Fuzzy, nostalgic and slightly wobbly.

name: Amberlight
description: The classic melodic-house pluck, done with character: detuned blended waves with a hard-sync sweep on every note, chorus, and a dotted echo with tape-style darkening.

name: Cassette Pluck
description: An electric-guitar pluck that sounds like it was bounced to tape and played back on a worn machine: tube warmth, a slow pitch wobble and rolled-off highs.

name: Copper Wire
description: A taut, metallic string pluck: the pluck-position table with a fast filter pinch, fattened by a bright saw sweep. Percussive and slightly dangerous.

name: Dew Drop
description: A tiny, delicate pluck: pure sine-harmonic tone with an FM sparkle on top, high in the register and drenched in reverb. Beautiful for sparse, intimate toplines.

name: Ember Pluck
description: A hard-sync sweep on every note: a sine restarts several times per cycle and the ratio collapses as the note decays, giving a vowel-like 'yow'. Retro and punchy.

name: Glass Orchard
description: Bright, bell-like FM pluck whose modulation index decays with each note, over a shimmer of sparse glass harmonics an octave up. Icy and expensive-sounding in a dotted echo.

name: Hollow Wood
description: A dry, hollow wooden pluck: a clarinet-table tone with a pulse wave underneath. Fast, rhythmic and sits well beside a shaker.

name: Kalimba Rain
description: A thumb-piano pluck that scatters into a long, cascading echo like rain on a tin roof. A recorded-mallet body with a bright metallic ping layered on top.

name: Marimba Dusk
description: A warm, wooden marimba voice with a deep body and a bright mallet click, moving gently in the stereo field. Sunset-on-a-patio organic house.

name: Moonlit Pluck
description: A warm acoustic-guitar pluck doubled by a soft piano an octave up, widened with chorus and answered by a dotted echo. The kind of line that sits over a late-night chord loop.

name: Paper Lantern
description: A soft, felted piano-like pluck with a faint sine halo, drifting off into a long airy reverb. Quiet, delicate and a little melancholy.

name: Silk Road
description: A harp-like plucked pair: two recorded guitar tones an octave apart, panned wide, with chorus and a warm dotted echo. Flowing, exotic and hand-played in feel.

name: Sparkler
description: A high, fizzing bell pluck: FM and Fibonacci partials stacked for a glittering burst that dies fast. A lovely topline over deep, dark chords.

name: Sugar Glass
description: A sparkling, sharp-edged pluck from a plucked-string algorithm table plus glass harmonics, thrown through a triplet echo. Candy-bright and very danceable.

name: Unalived Rat
description: A tight, squelchy progressive-house pluck: detuned saws, a resonant 24 dB filter that snaps shut on every note and a hint of glide in mono so quick runs slur. A bit out of genre for deep house, but it cuts through anything.

name: Velvet Pick
description: A mellow, rounded guitar pluck with a gentle tube glow: the lowpass sits low so the pick attack stays soft. Intimate and easy on the ears.

name: Wishing Well
description: A single pluck dropped into a very deep, echoing space: Fibonacci-bell partials under an FM sine, with a long reverb and a slow dotted echo. Plays like a coin falling into water.

name: Aurora Static
description: Shimmering curtains of hand-drawn and overtone waves with a fine veil of noise on top, rippling in and out of the stereo field. Cold, electric and quietly beautiful.

name: Black Glass
description: A dark, tense texture: distorted waves and glass harmonics under a closed filter that creeps open and shut, ending in a long, dark reverb. Menacing, sleek and glossy.

name: Choir Of Machines
description: A choir that is half human and half circuit: recorded voices intertwined with chip oscillators and a vowel sweep, the machines singing slightly out of tune with the humans.

name: City Hum
description: The low drone of a city at night: a digital bass table and a tonewheel organ with a faint noise floor and slow, chaotic movement. Subtle, ominous and surprisingly musical.

name: Coral Reef
description: Bubbles and shimmers rising through water: mallet and glass tones with sample-and-hold flicker on wave position and level, a bright triplet echo, and a wet, shifting stereo field.

name: Dust Devil
description: A whirling column of noise and a sharp, resonant peak sweeping up and down the spectrum in time with the bar. Dry, windy and restless - a texture that demands to be filtered.

name: Electric Orchard
description: A shimmering, metallic orchard: two FM tables whose modulation indices rise and fall independently, turning slow chords into a glittering, fruit-bearing canopy of overtones.

name: Lorenz Cloud
description: A cloud of voices and random spectra steered entirely by the Lorenz attractor: every axis moves a different part of the sound - filter, wave position, level and stereo - so the cloud morphs and never repeats.

name: Neon Rain
description: Droplets of glitter falling at random: sparse glass harmonics and a bird-call table, with sample-and-hold steering the wave position and the stereo image, caught in a dotted echo and a bright reverb.

name: Signal Ghost
description: A haunted digital whisper: video-game and chip-oscillator tones smeared through a long, feedback-heavy echo until only the ghosts of the notes remain, drifting across the field.

name: Sonar
description: Slow pings in a dark ocean: a sparse pattern locked to the host tempo strikes a bell-tone every few beats, and each ping falls away into a deep dotted echo and a vast reverb. Hold a note and it pings by itself.

name: Static Garden
description: A gritty granular layer and crackling noise blooming into soft, detuned pads: lo-fi, tactile and alive, like a transistor radio left on in an overgrown greenhouse.

name: Underwater Cathedral
description: A vast sunken cathedral: organ and brass tones behind a closed filter and a slow, flanging wash, as if heard through a hundred metres of water.

name: Vinyl Smoke
description: A distant piano drifting behind a haze of vinyl crackle and tape wobble, saturated and softened into a warm blur. A memory of a record, more than a record.
